title: Blue universal preference and regional color meanings
statement:
Blue is universally preferred across cultures and consistently signifies high quality, while colors like red and white vary drastically in meaning by region.

Options:
- Universal Safety: #0D47A1 (Global Blue) (fits: international brands, global saas)
- Prosperity (Asia) / Excitement (West): #B71C1C (Red) (fits: localized asian markets, western sales)
- Luxury / Mourning: #000000 (Black) (fits: high end fashion)
appliesWhen: Applies to: internationalization, global brands. Audience: general.

source.title: Managing Images in Different Cultures: A Cross-National Study of Color Meanings and Preferences
source.authors: Thomas J. Madden; Kelly Hewett; Martin S. Roth
